newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP sells S.African gold interest. [CORRECTED 03:51 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP sells S.African gold interest. [CORRECTED 03:51 GMT]

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it had sold its 20 percent stake in Sun Prospecting and Mining Co Ltd (Sun Gold) in South Africa to Anglovaal for A$60 million. (Company corrects sale price from the A$460 million figure it announced earlier to the Australian Stock Exchange)
BHP said the sale would result in a profit of approximately A$45 million. Sun Gold is a gold prospect which has not been developed, it said.
Sun Gold became part of the BHP portfolio through the company's acquisition of Utah International in 1984, it said.
The sale did not represent any alteration to BHP's interest in developing quality gold projects when appropriate opportunities occur, said BHP, a steel, minerals and petroleum group.
At 1.00 p.m. (0300 GMT), BHP shares were four cents up at A$17.04. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
